reference.role: Appearance guidance only; acceptance captures are actual software renders

review: Reviewed all 33 domain and 21 junction captures, ordinary desktop and narrow flight-height captures, the three flight sequence frames, all 28 appearance/diagnostic/translation-turn captures, and the nine three-frame surface-stability families.

Actual software renders show matte mineral-red faces, fine pores, restrained per-piece variation, shallow bevel highlights and filled joints. Brick bodies stay buried. The generated mockup is an appearance reference only.

Curves, cul-de-sacs, headers, source cuts, parking exclusions, building shadows and crossing ordering remain coherent. No rectangular streaming seams or flashes were observed in the reviewed sequences.
Direct specular stays subdued and nonzero; diagnostics separate it from diffuse lighting and haze. Production exposure, atmosphere and post-processing restore after diagnostics.

Verified all ten route/profile timing cases: 60 alternating paired samples in three blocks, equal camera/scene inputs/render sizes, no video encoder during timing; all within 20% median and 25% p95 overhead. These are environment-specific overhead measurements, not universal FPS.
Independent ready near-region coverage passes for every domain; minimum desktop domain fixture coverage is 0.9669555796316359. Inspection fixtures pass desktop/narrow thresholds.
The 100px welcome bar, original measurements/downloads, normal flight and accessible 2D fallback pass automated acceptance. The standalone sample and its shared sources are unchanged.
